item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { createRequire } from 'node:module'
import ts from 'typescript'
import { renderToStaticMarkup } from 'react-dom/server'

const require = createRequire(import.meta.url)
let requestHeaders = new Headers({ host: 'localhost:3000', cookie: 'session=test', authorization: 'Bearer test' })
const source = readFileSync('app/UserProfile.tsx', 'utf8')
const { outputText } = ts.transpileModule(source, {
  compilerOptions: { module: ts.ModuleKind.CommonJS, jsx: ts.JsxEmit.ReactJSX, target: ts.ScriptTarget.ES2017 },
})
const componentModule = { exports: {} }
new Function('require', 'module', 'exports', outputText)(
  (name) => name === 'next/headers' ? { headers: async () => requestHeaders } : require(name),
  componentModule,
  componentModule.exports,
)
const UserProfile = componentModule.exports.default
let requestedUrl
let requestedOptions
const render = async () => renderToStaticMarkup(await UserProfile())
globalThis.fetch = async (url, options) => {
  requestedUrl = url.href
  requestedOptions = options
  return Response.json({ name: 'Ada Lovelace', email: 'ada@example.com' })
}
const markup = await render()
assert.match(markup, /Name: Ada Lovelace/)
assert.match(markup, /Email: ada@example.com/)
assert.equal(requestedUrl, 'http://localhost:3000/api/users/profile')
assert.equal(requestedOptions.headers.get('cookie'), 'session=test')
assert.equal(requestedOptions.headers.get('authorization'), 'Bearer test')
assert.equal(requestedOptions.cache, 'no-store')
requestHeaders = new Headers({ 'x-forwarded-host': 'example.com', 'x-forwarded-proto': 'https' })
await render()
assert.equal(requestedUrl, 'https://example.com/api/users/profile')
globalThis.fetch = async () => new Response('Unauthorized', { status: 401 })
assert.match(await render(), /Unable to load user profile\\./)
globalThis.fetch = async () => { throw new Error('Network unavailable') }
assert.match(await render(), /Unable to load user profile\\./)
globalThis.fetch = async () => new Response('invalid JSON')
assert.match(await render(), /Unable to load user profile\\./)
requestHeaders = new Headers()
assert.match(await render(), /Unable to load user profile\\./)
console.log('Profile rendering checks passed: success, session forwarding, proxy URL, HTTP error, network error, invalid JSON, and missing host.')
NODE"

item.text:
Implemented [UserProfile.tsx](/workspace/app/UserProfile.tsx) using the existing async server-component pattern. It fetches `/api/users/profile`, displays the user’s name and email, preserves session credentials, and shows a fallback message if loading fails. The dashboard already includes the component.

TypeScript, the production build, and mocked success/error rendering checks passed. Live API integration remains unverified because this repository doesn’t define the endpoint.
